ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Matter delivery, Cleared to start and later stages need Engagement letter signed date and AML check status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Opening", 1, "Cleared to start", 2, "In progress", 3, "Awaiting client", 4, "Final billing", 5, "Closed", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Engagement_letter_signed_date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Aml_check_status__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Engagement letter signed date and AML check status before moving to Cleared to start.
